# Operations Service Standard Updates

This document outlines critical updates and reviews required for operations service standards:

*   Update cash flow based on audit findings.
*   Update teller performance metrics for Strategy 2026.
*   Review branch efficiency on a quarterly basis.
*   Investigate customer wait times as part of Strategy 2026 initiatives.
*   Review overall teller performance for Strategy 2026.
